rows.what_the_ink_shows: In the displayed algebra presentation, the last generator is U_n and the last differential generator is dU_n. Each final subscript consists only of the small n stroke before the closing delimiter; no minus sign or 1 follows it. In the immediately preceding definition, U_{n-1} and X_{n-1} visibly contain separate minus and 1 strokes, which are absent from the disputed presentation. Viewed full scan and both enlarged contrast crops.
rows.note: L344.R1: The reported n−1 correction, including its attribution to Michel Hua, is contradicted as a literal reading of this displayed presentation. The original U_n and dU_n agree with the ink. The preceding definition and range explain why U_{n−1}, dU_{n−1} are the mathematical intention, but this is an authorial index slip rather than a transcription misreading. Preserve both written n indices.
